about: The art kit (OP-229): seamless textures and keyed shape sheets the level assembler (OP-234) builds screens from. Texture keys are kit-tex-<name>, 512 x 512, tileable. A sheet key is kit-sheet-<name>: one 2048 x 1152 painting on the key colour, six props in a grid of three across and two down, cut by `art:finish pieces` into the pieces listed here in reading order, each shipped as kit-<piece> at its logical size (w x h, 1x and 2x) with its alpha. tools/art/README.md describes the format. An area set is kit.areas.<area>: its accent textures (kit-tex-<area>-<name>), its prop sheets (kit-sheet-<area>-<name>, cut to kit-<area>-<piece>) and its seven backdrop layers (kit-<area>-sky-a|b 1600 x 900 opaque, kit-<area>-far-a|b 1600 x 900 keyed, kit-<area>-mid-a|b|c 800 x 450 keyed), every one repeating sideways so the assembler can run it along any screen. Course props are kit.courses.<area>.<sheet>: extra six-prop sheets for a course, keyed and cut like the area's own (kit-sheet-<area>-<name> to kit-<area>-<piece>). Landmarks are kit.landmarks.<name>: one prop each on its own 1024 x 1024 key-colour canvas (kit-sheet-landmark-<name>), cut by art:finish pieces to kit-landmark-<name>.
